title: Follon trusted acceptance reviewer key set
description: The keys whose signatures make an acceptance record count. An operator provisions and controls this file. An empty set trusts no one, so no record counts. A reviewer who leaves is removed by writing a new set, and every audit and promotion receipt names the SHA-256 of the set it used.

public_key_hex.description: The 32-byte Ed25519 public key, as `follon-admin release-keygen` writes it in a trusted key file.
